settings.question: How much is delivery?
settings.answer: Shipping charges are calculated at checkout from your destination, order weight and the shipping method you choose. Free standard shipping may be available on selected orders, as shown at checkout.

settings.question: Where do you ship?
settings.answer: We currently ship to Canada, the United Kingdom and the United States.

settings.question: How long will my order take?
settings.answer: Orders are processed within 1 business day (excluding holidays). Orders placed after noon, or at weekends and on holidays, may start processing the next business day. Delivery estimates for your address are shown at checkout; they’re estimates, not guarantees, and start once your order ships.

settings.question: Will I have to pay customs or import charges?
settings.answer: Orders to Canada, the UK and the EU may be subject to taxes, duties and carrier fees. Where these are collected at checkout they’re shown before you pay. Otherwise they may be due before or at delivery. See our shipping policy for details.

settings.question: Where is my order?
settings.answer: As soon as your order ships we’ll email you a confirmation with a tracking number and link. Tracking can take a little while to update after you receive it. If you’re still unsure, use Track your order and we’ll look into it.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel my order?
settings.answer: You can request a cancellation for 15 minutes after placing your order. After that, contact us as soon as possible: we may be able to make changes before it ships, but once it’s in transit we can’t modify it. Send us a message with your order number.

settings.question: Can I correct my delivery address?
settings.answer: Please check your address at checkout. If it needs correcting, contact us as soon as possible with your order number.

settings.question: How do I return something?
settings.answer: You can request a return within 30 days after your item is delivered. Items need to be unworn or unused, with tags, in their original packaging. Contact us before sending anything back: items returned without a request aren’t accepted. Start on our Return a product page. Return shipping is free and we’ll provide a label.

settings.question: When will I get my refund?
settings.answer: We’ll let you know once we’ve received and inspected your return. If it’s approved, you’ll be refunded to your original payment method. Your bank or payment provider may need extra time to process it. If you haven’t seen it after a reasonable time, contact us.

settings.question: I’m in the UK or EU. Do I have extra rights?
settings.answer: If you’re a consumer in the UK or EU you may have the right to cancel within 14 days after receiving your goods, unless an exemption applies. See our refund policy for the full details.

settings.question: Can I exchange an item?
settings.answer: Contact us before returning your item to ask about exchange options.

settings.question: What if my item arrives damaged or faulty?
settings.answer: Please inspect your order when it arrives and contact us straight away if an item is defective or damaged, or if you received the wrong item.

settings.question: How do I make a warranty claim?
settings.answer: Use our Request a warranty page with your order number and a description of the problem, and we’ll come back to you.

settings.question: How do I contact you?
settings.answer: You can send us a message, email hello@naturalstate.run, or find other ways to reach us on our Contact us page.

settings.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: The payment methods available to you are shown at checkout, including major credit and debit cards.

settings.question: Is my payment secure?
settings.answer: Yes. Payments are processed securely at checkout and we never see or store your full card details.

settings.question: How do your sizes fit?
settings.answer: Each product page has a size guide. If you’re between sizes, we’d suggest sizing up for a looser fit on the run.

settings.question: How should I wash my gear?
settings.answer: Wash cold with similar colours, avoid fabric softener and tumble dry on low or hang to dry. Full care details are on each product page.

settings.title: Send us a message
settings.text: Our team will get back to you shortly with answers about our products and orders.

settings.title: Contact us by email
settings.text: Prefer email? Write to us any time and we’ll reply within one working day.
